text_block_list.text:
In short, a total of 7!!
Now, whatever could this number be for~!?
choice_data_list: The number of watermelons smashed during training camp
The number of cicada shells collected during training camp

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The answer was: "The number of super-stylish brooches McQueen owns"~!
—This has nothing to do with the summer training camp anymore!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Since you got it wrong, walk your butt all the way back to the Academy~!
See ya!!

"...Before getting left behind,
I rushed onto the bus!!"
